# OxiPNG browser encoder

The single-threaded JavaScript glue and WebAssembly binary come from
[@jsquash/oxipng 2.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jsquash/oxipng/v/2.3.0)
under `codec/pkg/`. The glue's file extension is `.mjs` for static serving.
The codec is OxiPNG 3.0.0. See both bundled license files.
